newsitem.title: MEXICO: Zedillo sees higher Mexico exports this year.
newsitem.headline: Zedillo sees higher Mexico exports this year.

text.p: President Ernesto Zedillo said Tuesday that Mexico's exports this year would "without doubt" rise to $100 billion from $80 billion last year.
Speaking to a business breakfast, Zedillo noted that Mexico's trade surplus had risen 20 percent in the first seven months of this year against the same period last year.

"For this reason we believe that at the end of the year we will have surpassed by a wide margin the $80 billion in exports reached in 1995 and we will reach, without doubt, the target referred to by Juan Elek," Zedillo said.
Earlier, Juan Elek, president of the Mexican Business Council for International Affairs, had said he expected exports this year to reach $100 billion.
